title: [Discussion] Embed Agent Friendly Code Score Badge
body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests. - [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue. ### Summary Hello team, I am Himanshu. I am working on a side project that scores repos for agent friendliness. Streamlit has an overall 90.8 score. Would it be possible to add a badge for it in the README? You can use this - ``` [![Agent Friendly](https://agentfriendlycode.com/api/badge/github/streamlit/streamlit.svg)](https://agentfriendlycode.com/repo/60) ``` ### The Badge [![Agent Friendly](https://agentfriendlycode.com/api/badge/github/streamlit/streamlit.svg)](https://agentfriendlycode.com/repo/60) ### Breakdown of the score https://www.agentfriendlycode.com/repo/60 ---
